Method of Attack: Ransomware infection linked to a group of cybercriminals called Black Hunt
Breaches corporate networks and spreads laterally to other devices
Deploys encryptors that clear Windows event logs, delete Shadow Volume Copies and NTFS journals, disable Windows recovery options
Disables Microsoft Defender, adds new users, disables System Restore, Task Manager, and Run command
Encrypts files appending extensions in the format [unique_id].[contact_email].Hunt2 or [unique_id].[contact_email].Black
Creates ransom notes #BlackHunt_ReadMe.hta and #BlackHunt_ReadMe.txt in every folder
Discoverer: Cybersecurity researchers reported attacks at the end of 2022
Impacted Systems: Windows devices infected by Black Hunt ransomware
Tigo Business Paraguay infrastructure as a service
More than 300 companies associated with Tigo Business
Indicators of Compromise: Deleted Shadow Volume Copies and NTFS journals
Disabled Windows recovery options and Microsoft Defender
Emails provided in ransom notes for contacting threat actors
